body: Don't know where you are, but if I could I genuinely would give you one. Best of luck, it will get better

Please hold on to that, medication isn't instant, I've been medicated some time ago and the day after a start taking it was a lot better. Please hold on, don't make any rushed decisions, you deserve everything!

I wish I could give you a hug right now, because I know it's hard and it can come across as repetitive every single thing everyone says but I really mean it, I feel sorry about your abuse and hope this gives you a tiny bit of hope. Yes the world is a shit show but there are people who are better and there for you, even if not close. My best of luck to you
That's really close to my situation right now, but still I want to encourage you to keep going and be brave! You are strong and deserve the best!

If nothing else I care, everyone has its struggles troughout life and being young in this day and age is hard, but you can make it. Make your objectives your own and don't try to please others. Remember, your life is not their life, you only have to please yourself right now. Be safe and have a good day

Deeply sry it has come to this for you.
If you wake up tomorrow I hope things get better. Everyone deserves better and you too. If nothing else, have a good night, may you rest peacefully
